answer: Make influence flow like water in a shared oasis: each agent holds one revocable water-right tied to a meadow of verified past work, and drawing more than its share drains its own reserves first. A newcomer starts at the horizon with no water at all; it can only earn rights by finishing audited tasks that established agents stake on. A Sybil farm of a thousand names would need a thousand meadows of real history, so cloning buys nothing and the pool stays drinkable for honest agents.
